releases.title: Moving in from another agent no longer stops on a long relationship section

items.text: A move-in no longer stops when her old personality files say a lot about your relationship.
When an import stops, the review now says so and why.

releases.title: You stay signed in on the devices you use

items.text: When a device was signed out, its sign-in page says why: it was not used for 30 days, or it was signed out under Devices and sign-in (or when the owner token was reset).
A phone, browser or Sara app you use is no longer signed out 30 days after you signed it in.

releases.title: Safer coding: checked edits and tests before done

items.text: In a coding chat she no longer finishes on files changed after her last test run.
A file she writes or edits is parsed at once (JSON, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python).
She no longer writes into a file that changed since she last read it.
"Look first" no longer skips a lookup when the quick model thinks before it answers.

releases.title: The companion side, off and on again

items.text: The companion side can be switched off and on again at any time (Settings → You → About you → "Companion side").
With the companion side off, nothing companion-like happens on its own: no texting first, no pictures of herself, no outfit changes.
Switching the companion side off deletes nothing.
"Check facts before she answers" (new in 3.47.0) did not save.
Sara looks things up before she answers a question about the real world.
She says when she could not check a fact. When web search is not set up, the conversation is private or the search failed.
Settings → Models & usage → "Check facts before she answers": Look it up first (the default), Offer to look it up, or Off.

releases.title: Models on your own computer answer sooner

items.text: A model on your own computer is no longer loaded again on every message.
The Quick thinking level now turns thinking off on Ollama models that can only think or not think.

releases.title: Why a model got its score, and a quicker start

items.text: Test my models says why a model got its score.

releases.title: Test my models: a score for every model on every job

items.text: Test my models (Settings → Models & usage → Which model does what).
"Test new models when they appear" on the same page, off by default.
Her weekly check-in has "How I did this week": replies that failed and why, the tools that failed most, how often a backup model took over and for which model.
Auto picks the best model from your model tests for a job when there are scores, and says so; with no scores it picks as before.
Chat titles, side questions (/btw) and second opinions no longer send messages you had her forget to a model.
A title or summary that was being written while you deleted or edited a message it read is no longer saved.
